title: Move Checklist Critical Path Slip
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=move:checklist phase=* task_status=* days_before_move=*
| where task_status!="done" AND days_before_move<=7
| stats count as open_critical_tasks, min(days_before_move) as nearest_deadline by phase
| sort nearest_deadline
description: Lists move checklist tasks still open within seven days of move date grouped by phase.
value: Critical-path slips on utilities, COA, and mover confirmations cascade into expensive move-day chaos.
implementation: Tag each checklist task with `days_before_move` and review open critical items daily the final week.
visualization: Table of phases with open task count and nearest deadline.
grandmaExplanation: It watches important move tasks still not done when moving day is only a week away.
